name: authflow
description: Put your MCP server on Authflow: free or paid access through one OAuth sign-in, with the agent doing the setup. Connects the Authflow management and docs MCPs and adds onboarding skills.

interface.shortDescription: Onboard and monetize your MCP server on Authflow
interface.longDescription: Connects the Authflow management MCP (sign in with Google or GitHub) and the public docs MCP. Skills guide the agent through creating a free or paid MCP, integrating the Origin Protocol into your server, connecting Stripe, verifying, and publishing.
defaultPrompt: Use Authflow to put this repository's MCP server behind a free Authflow sign-in.
Use Authflow to check what is still blocking my MCP from going live.
